canonical_source.behavior: Switch language toggles English/Arabic and reloads the public page.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: A real same-origin navigation toggles only en/ar, stores a session locale and server-renders all public page content with matching lang and dir. Unsupported or structured input is ignored; no caller-provided return URL or tenant is accepted. Works without JavaScript or localStorage.

tenant_isolation: Canonical source is anonymous. This control remains identity-neutral with no tenant alias; tests prove foreign tenant path is 404, tenant/user query input has no authority, and authenticated user data is absent. No tenant data or credentials are read.
